15.20.7a5cc9

Winter Update 2025

Released on November 24, 2025.

General Properties

Update Version

15.20.7a5cc9

Type

Major
Winter

Previous Update

15.13.02dfc3
(Major: 15.10.46b862)

Next Update

15.20.8007a5
(Major: 15.30.a30dad)

Summary

Introduction of the new Order of the Stag Quest and The Roost of the Graveborn Quest. Rework of the Hunting Tasks into the Bounty Task system. New spell effects configuration to allow opacity adjustments. New weapons, equipments, and mount.

See also: Updates Help

Update Video

Update Teasers

  1. Order of the Stag
  2. Spell Opacity
  3. Roost of the Graveborn
  4. Improved Object Targeting and Multiaction Button
  5. New Task System I
  6. New Task System II
  7. Winter Update Changes during Test Server

Test Server

  • On November 04, 2025, the 2025 Winter Update Test Server began.
  • On November 18, 2025, the 2025 Winter Update Test Server ended.

Changes

  • New Order of the Stag Quest, for premium account players who finished The Order of the Lion Quest, introducing a new storyline about the mysterious and tragic fate of the Etzel bloodline.
    • Inclusion of the The Order of the Stag, led by Eldoran the Ambitious, heir to Eldoran, the lost bastard of the Etzel clan.
    • New area and hunting ground, with difficulty level slightly higher than that of the Falcon Bastion.
    • New boss, dropping new equipment and a mount.
  • New Spell Effects menu added under Options, allowing players to adjust opacity of their own spells, other players’ spells, and monster spells.
  • Inclusion of a new The Roost of the Graveborn Quest for premium account players over level 450, where a mysterious necromancer emerges and puts Tibia’s dragons in danger.
    • A new challenge focused on boss encounters with specific mechanics, with difficulty level comparable to the Soul War Quest.
    • New powerful weapons, with proficiency trees and new Perks (such as Elemental Pierce), a new achievement, and other rewards.
      • Changes to Expose Weakness, Ballistic Mastery, and Amplification Potions to reflect the new Elemental Pierce rules.
  • Implementation of a new option that allows players to apply an object directly to whatever lies beneath their mouse cursor, reducing the number of required clicks from two to one.
  • Implementation of a new Multi-Action Button, that allows players to assign multiple actions to the same button, cycling through them with repeated clicks or key presses.
  • Introduction of Bounty Tasks
    • A new Task Board will be the starting point for selecting future hunting activities.
    • Each completed Bounty Task rewards Experience , Bounty Points , and Reroll Tokens , used for enhancing the new Bounty Talisman.
    • Each completed Weekly Task rewards Hunting Task Points , and Soulseals .

New Achievements

Name Grade Points Prem Secret Description
Bastard

5 ✓ ✗ You freed the remnants of the Order of the Stag on the Isle of Ada from a warlock's yoke. An evil puppet master who lead many Stags against their own brethren. Eldoran the Ambitious, heir of Eldoran Etzel, Cadwgan's bastard son, is forever grateful.
Errand Runner

3 ✗ ✗ Your stash is cleared, your bestiary completed but the grind has only just begun.
Feral Trapper

2 ✗ ✗ You've learned the way of the wilderness: its patience, its fury, its grace. As a feral trapper, you embody them all.
Lost Letters

3 ✗ ✓ Many letters have been written by knights of the Order of the Stag. Some personal while others were simply a mistake. We often ask ourselves what happened to these once corresponding souls, we hope for the best but have to fear for the worst.
Mimic (Achievement)

1 ✓ ✓ Apparently not all chests are the same. Some have a life of their own and if you think about it... how do so many of them actually refill every day? Well, you're one step closer to revealing this secret
Pest Control

7 ✗ ✗ From rotworms in caves to dragons in the sky, no creature is safe from your overzealous swatting.
Razor's Edge

4 ✓ ✓ That has been a close call ...
Stagmeister

1 ✓ ✓ Modifying Brewmaster Bhaan's Raubritter Lager with a hint of Night Harpy, you received a potent remedy against their vicious attacks. Drinking so much of it however, you wonder what other side effects it has as you stare at the moon... mesmerised...
Taskaholic

✗ ✗ You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.
Workhorse

5 ✗ ✗ Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
